articles.title: White House crypto adviser says Trump gave up 'historic' ethics powers in compromise
articles.snippet: President Donald Trump's digital assets adviser spoke at a Washington event the day after a new compromise language was released for the Clarity Act.

articles.title: Banks escalate stablecoin rewards fight as Senate prepares for a Clarity Act vote
articles.snippet: Eight banking groups on Monday said they want tighter limits on stablecoin rewards, keeping the ongoing banks-versus-crypto dispute alive in Congress.

articles.title: Bitmine adds $68 million in ether as Tom Lee sees more upside catalysts ahead
articles.snippet: The Ethereum treasury firm is closing in on its 5% accumulation goal as Lee points to a rising ETH-BTC ratio and institutional demand.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin climbs near $79,000 as stocks narrow declines
articles.snippet: The Federal Reserve's two-day policy meeting begins tomorrow, with nearly all now expecting the U.S. central bank to hike its benchmark policy rate by 25 basis points.

articles.title: Why are AI’s biggest companies suddenly asking to slow down?
articles.snippet: AI’s biggest labs are suddenly calling for a slower pace of development. Is it because AI risks are catching up with the technology, or because the economics of the race are getting harder to justify?
